title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.67 (active) at 02:00 UTC on 5 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 3.67（活躍）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.67 (4M) at 02:00 UTC on 5 October 2026. The 02:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 02:59; hour-start 3.67/4M, hour-end 4.00/4Z). Last-180 maximum is 5.00 (first at 2026-10-05T03:47:00Z; label 5Z). Published-window maximum is 5.00 (first at 2026-10-05T03:47:00Z; label 5Z). Window start 2026-10-04T22:01:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp reached 5.00 this window. The 03 UTC on 2026-10-05 hour is still incomplete (59 samples through 03:58).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
